scope: Concept diagram only; no game code changes.
userClarification: Initial pivot is piece-plane center P at Y=h
centerC: shared display-frame center and rotation pivot; initially P, origin command goes to O
operation: Move view frame and pivot together; preserve orientation on origin translation. Axis preset selection preserves C.
YW90: H: Y=C_y; at C=P all sample centers remain in exact slice, at C=O no sample centers remain if h is nonzero
XW90: H: X=0 for both centers; Y offset does not distinguish this rotation.
